reason: We have to replace lost volume and my team of three only looks after existing accounts, so I need new meetings from somewhere. EUR 1,600 for at least 5 meetings is about EUR 320 each with the money back if they fail, so the downside is small. I would do the free 15-company list first, and I would only sign the pilot in Relationship mode where I approve every company and every message.
objection: Our name is all we have in freight. One sloppy cold email to a shipper, or a GDPR complaint, costs me more than EUR 1,600. And 'a logistics client got 45 meetings' with no name and no reference I can call is not proof to me yet.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or wrong for our lanes, or they will not give me a named reference I can call, I walk away.
